note: Single source of truth for Step 34 delivery budgets. Read by scripts/measure-delivery.mjs (gates the run) and scripts/check-budgets.mjs (re-checks the last written report). Byte budgets are EXACT INTEGER BYTES — never rounded to MB before comparing. Definitions of every window and metric: docs/context/DELIVERY-BUDGETS.md.

units.bytes: exact transfer bytes (response body + response headers), MiB = 1048576 B
units.ms: milliseconds since navigation start unless stated otherwise

arrivalBytes._desktop_note: 5.0 MiB exactly (5 * 1048576). A run at 5242880 passes; 5245261 (the last integration-branch number) fails by 2381 B and must be reported as a fail, not rounded to '5.00 MB PASS'.
arrivalBytes._phone_note: 0.8 MiB = 838860.8 B; rounded UP to the next whole byte so the budget is expressible as an integer.

routeBytes._note: 18 MiB desktop / 12 MiB phone. The plan states '12/18 MB' without naming the viewport; the larger figure goes to desktop, which loads the 1080 pour rung. See DEV-CONTRACT.md and DELIVERY-BUDGETS.md.

reported.clsScroll: Session-window CLS accumulated during the scripted scroll. Measured and printed, NEVER gated: a programmatic scrollIntoView storm is not a user's scroll, and the CLS spec's field metric does not include shifts the harness itself provoked.
reported.clsSession: Session-window CLS over the whole run (arrival + scroll + interaction). Diagnostic only.
reported.clsNaiveSum: Plain sum of every layout-shift value in the run. This is what the pre-Step-34 probe gated on and the reason it read exactly 1.0 / 2.0.
reported.fontBytes: Owned by Step 13 (subsetting). Reported here so a regression is visible; not gated by Step 34.
reported.videoPreload: Owned by Step 17. Reported here so a video that stops being preload=none/metadata is visible; not gated by Step 34.
